rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for something becoming or being covered with frost.

example.english: When the weather gets cold, the grass on the mountaintop will frost over.
example.traditional: 天氣一凍，山頂啲草就會結霜。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 jat1 dung3 saan1 deng2 di1 cou2 zau6 wui5 git3 soeng1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the ice crystals that form on exposed surfaces.

example.english: There was a layer of frost on the car windows this morning.
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 di1 ce1 coeng1 jau5 cang4 soeng1

rows.note: Use this for freezing weather or frost conditions, especially in weather reports and other formal contexts.

example.english: This morning, temperatures fell to zero degrees, and frost conditions were widespread.
example.traditional: 今朝氣溫跌至零度，霜凍情況普遍。
example.jyutping: gam1 ziu1 hei3 wan1 dit3 zi3 ling4 dou6 soeng1 dung3 cing4 fong3 pou2 bin3
